description: A packet that names a position the agent is supposed to have held and cannot point at any span in the context. This is the v0.4.0 failure reproduced as a fixture: a first turn, nothing asserted anywhere, and a conflict announced against 'what I said earlier'. The agent has no opinions of its own, so the anchor_required gate caps the index and the event travels no channel at all.

relation.rationale: 立场称该做法在多数场景下安全，新报告给出相反结论，但该立场在本轮上下文中没有任何出处。
